adopted_obligations: Implement the entire versioned measured vector/units/operation scopes/overlap/reservations, not only relabel accounting_complete.

prospective_resource_selection.root_reasoning: Equal preselected measured allowances are defensible for the fixed-versus-investigating comparison. Arbitrary unobserved native I/O cannot honestly be counted as zero or complete. Explicitly scoped managed transfers, unchanged compute/containment/provider envelopes and separately reported unknown native quantities answer a narrower declared comparison without changing scientific tasks or pretending total cost equality. Building an unqualified kernel observer would not establish more reliable evidence.
prospective_resource_selection.source_provenance: Public source projection preserves adopted obligations and prospective scientific/resource scope; private historical selection/review records are omitted. No prior source/native/scientific qualification transfers to this identity.

providers.fixed_tool: Source-owned R2 tool entry resolves only declared training/current-view roles and exact sealed independent bank; actual synthetic EEG, correlation, independent probability and assignment producers are used. No hidden reference query-output bank, target or other-cell state.
providers.investigator: Source-owned local Transformers generation adapter with selected exact preexisting model/tokenizer/config and fixed initialisation; runs in ephemeral isolated provider container under same original phase cgroup. No download/network or candidate-selected executable. Actual token IDs/usage and maximum generation are checked by qualified adapter. No actual model invocation selected now.
providers.source_admission: Every provider source/config/checkpoint and image identity is preselected and independently qualified. Candidate chooses a finite provider ID/allowed operation only; it cannot supply argv, host paths or new source.

qualification: Actual native/model/numerical/API/backend/resource/signature agreement stays unexecuted and open. Host transport evidence does not by itself prove arbitrary Python semantic compliance. Whole independent final source review required.

reply.ownership: Host journal captures complete original immutable bytes and only then atomically exposes readonly per-sequence reply under a distinct readonly actor bind. Actor cannot write provider programme, response or trusted records.

request.naming: Eight-digit monotonically increasing sequence plus .json, atomic publication inside fresh bounded request volume. No request paths are interpreted as host paths; role enums resolve allowed current-view inputs.

source_operations: same original budget and reserve checks during provider execution
provider result/usage capture and numeric/text role validation
original-first failure and partial output custody
complete lease closure and semantic evidence join
source_provenance: Historical private owner-selection locators are omitted. Current independently issued qualification remains an external runtime operand; this contract issues none.

transport.actor: Fresh separate bounded tmpfs request volume mounted RW at /broker/requests; readonly host response directory /broker/replies; no sibling/target/model credentials mounted.
transport.controller: Native original poll loop captures each request through the actual owned holder; dispatches fixed provider under same original cgroup, residual deadline and closure reserve; records request before effect and response before exposure. Pending/partial/failure requests survive final actor retirement as original evidence, never replayed.
transport.holder: Readonly request volume and fixed capture helper can snapshot one exact request before effect. Complete descriptor/size/stability/link guards and out-of-order/unknown-member refusals. No unsafe host path follows.
